item.title: Baseball Falls in Extras to Villanova
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Baseball team saw Villanova University score six in the top of the 10th inning to defeat the Bisons in the opening game of the three-game series, 11-5, Friday night inside Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Women's Tennis Drops Match at No. 28 Vanderbilt
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team battled a Vanderbilt University squad that saw six of the nine flights between singles and doubles ranked, as the Commodores swept the Bisons 7-0 on Friday evening from the Lummis Family Tennis Center.

item.title: Ushizima Sweeps Friday's Action; Men's Tennis Splits Opening Day of Arizona Trip
item.description: GLENDALE, Ariz. / PHOENIX – The Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team split on the team's first day of competition in Arizona, as the Bisons defeated Arizona Christian University, 4-1, before falling to No. 60 Grand Canyon University 6-1.

item.title: Lipscomb Falls to Coastal Carolina at Clemson Tournament
item.description: CLEMSON, SC – Lipscomb Softball dropped a 5–0 decision to Coastal Carolina on Saturday at the Clemson Tournament.

item.title: Women's Tennis Succumbs to Xavier in Saturday Matinee
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team suffered a 7-0 loss to Xavier University to open the outdoor portion of the home schedule on Saturday from the Huston-Marsh-Griffith Tennis Center.

item.title: Women's Basketball Taken Down by North Alabama
item.description: FLORENCE, Ala. – Despite 46 points in the paint and a career-high in scoring from Hope Counts, the the Lipscomb University Women's Basketball team, the Bisons suffered a 68-63 loss to the University of North Alabama, Saturday night from CB&S Bank Arena at Flowers Hall.

item.title: Down But Not Out; Baseball Takes Down Villanova with Seven Unanswered Runs
item.description: NASHVILLE – So far in Lipscomb's three wins, they all have one thing in common: coming from behind. On this Saturday from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium, the Bisons rallied from their largest deficit of the season in six thanks to seven unanswered runs, including five in the sixth to take down Villanova University by a 9-8 score.

item.title: Men's Basketball Defeats North Alabama on Senior Day
Bisons Drop Sunday Rematch to Coastal Carolina
item.description: CLEMSON, SC – Lipscomb Softball closed the weekend Sunday at the Clemson Tournament with a 10–2 loss to Coastal Carolina in the rematch.

item.title: Women's Golf Finishes Top Five at Space Coast Classic
item.description: VIERA, Fla. – Lipscomb Women's Golf finished tied for fifth out of 14 teams at the Space Coast Classic on Sunday. The Bisons were solid throughout the tournament, with round scores of 291, 294, 304 to finish (+25) on the event. Only one team in the field finished under par.
